hero_headline: Run Your Content Without a Team.
hero_sub: AuraFlux runs your content production from start to finish — transforming raw clips, videos, and ideas into polished, published content automatically.

steps.headline: Start With Any Source
steps.body: Submit a YouTube URL, Twitch VOD, Kick replay, or direct upload. AuraFlux ingests it instantly.

steps.headline: AuraFlux Publishes For You
steps.body: Our pipeline scripts, assembles, applies brand chrome, QA-checks, and queues your content for publish.

steps.headline: Automated Production
steps.body: Six production portals run in sequence — each one verified before the next begins. No manual steps.

steps.headline: Content Published
steps.body: Your content lands on every connected platform with the right format, captions, and metadata. Done.

final_cta_headline: Stop Managing Content. Start Producing It.
final_cta_sub: No team, no editors, no upload queues. AuraFlux handles the entire pipeline from source to publish.
